card.name: Linking words before place names
card.fires_on: The small word or comma right after an organization, person's role or town and just before a city, town or region name, such as "of", "in" or a comma before a place.

modes.label: "of" before a town
modes.description: The word "of" linking a person, direction or place type to a town name that comes next.

modes.label: Comma before location
modes.description: A comma after an institution or city that is followed by a place such as a state or country.
modes.example: El Chico National Park located near Pachuca City<<,>> Hidalgo, Mexico (98

modes.label: "in" after a hospital
modes.description: The word "in" after a hospital or workplace name, leading to its location.
modes.example: Huron Valley Sinai Hospital<< in>> Commerce Township.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward proper place names such as Boise or Chinese city names coming next, and away from common words like corn.
card.plain: It fires on the small link word just before the name of a town or city is given.
